- Props / demo: will you be doing a live demo or a screen-sharing walk-through? If live, please list hardware (laptop model, adapters) so Ben can prep adapters.
- Visuals: we need a headshot (300–600px wide) and a 40–60 word bio by EOD Friday so we can finalize the panel page.
- AV test: we have a 20-minute AV check window the morning of the event (9/29). If you can't make that slot, we can pre-record a 3–4 minute clip as backup.

Attached: speaker-one-packet.docx (guidelines) and a draft run_of_show_v2.pdf that Lauren is updating.

Can you confirm availability for the AV check and whether you plan to do a live demo? Once we have that we can finalize the run of show and calendar invite.
